fields.standard: plain HTML inputs with stable names: resume (file), name (full name, one box), email, phone, location, org (current company), urls[LinkedIn], urls[GitHub], urls[Portfolio]; required marked by '✱' in the label and the required attribute
fields.custom_questions: named cards[<card id>][fieldN]; the question text is the label beside them

location.widget: input.location-input (name=location) with a hidden input#selected-location (name=selectedLocation) and a dropdown of server results
location.pick: type the city, wait for .dropdown-results to fill, click the result that matches; the click fills selectedLocation -- typed text alone leaves it empty

fields.choice: native <select> (e.g. 'How did you hear': 21 options, first 'Select...')

university.widget: native <select> with 3302 schools; first option is a notice, not a school; 'Other - School Not Listed' exists
university.pick: exact official name ('Eastern Illinois University', never 'Northeastern Illinois University'); an abbreviation ('JNTU') matches nothing -- the list has 'Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University - Hyderabad' and '- Kakinada', so the profile must hold the full name and campus

fields.multi_select: a list of checkboxes sharing one cards[...] name (languages: 34 options incl. 'Choose not to disclose', 'Other'); required means at least one ticked
fields.long_answer: textarea; 'ADDITIONAL INFORMATION' textarea name=comments is the cover letter box
fields.consent: radio 'Yes, I consent' / 'No, I do not consent', and a marketing-consent checkbox consent[marketing] -- the owner's decision
